mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SEARCH_HISTORIES ( HISTORY_ID, USER_ID, KEYWORD, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_SEARCH_HISTORIES.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{keyword}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID, USER_ID, KEYWORD, CREATED_AT FROM SEARCH_HISTORIES WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
